summary: The diff implements String.prototype.toLowerCase steps 1-7 in order: RequireObjectCoercible and ToString are propagated with `?`, StringToCodePoints and CodePointsToString are implemented as local helpers with correct lone-surrogate handling, and toLowercase applies the per-code-point full mapping. The only context-sensitive rule, Final_Sigma (U+03A3 to U+03C2), is implemented faithfully against the Unicode Default Case Conversion condition: the nearest non-Case_Ignorable character before must be Cased, and the nearest non-Case_Ignorable character after must not be Cased. Missing Unicode tables (Cased, Case_Ignorable) return the engine's not-implemented error rather than a guess. No test-specific branches, no swallowed errors, no unrelated edits. The only c == 0x03A3 check is the spec's own Final_Sigma condition.
notes_for_next_attempt: Minor, not blocking: (1) The diff deletes the stub's spec prose ("The result must be derived according to the locale-insensitive case mappings..." and the NOTE paragraphs about multi-code-point mappings and non-symmetry). Restore them as comments so the file keeps the spec text, as the ticket asks. (2) Lint at line 84: `s_text.iter().skip(i + 1)` walks from the start each time. Use `s_text[i + 1..].iter()` instead. (3) is_final_sigma scans backward and forward per U+03A3, so long runs of case-ignorable characters make it quadratic. This is acceptable, but it is worth a comment. I could not verify from the diff that kahvi_unicode::to_lowercase returns the full SpecialCasing mapping (for example U+0130 giving 0069 0307); confirm this against the test262 results for that code point.
